name: Titan O1
summary: Titan O1 is Westlake Robotics’ humanoid robot platform, presented as a physical platform for embodied AI models. It combines an articulated humanoid body with an open architecture and the company’s robot behavior models. The official catalog describes integration of motion control, perception and embodied AI. The primary image retains the manufacturer’s genuine upper-body product render; commercial shipping availability is unverified.
